name: promptfoo-redteam-run
description: Execute, inspect, and rerun an existing Promptfoo redteam scan. Use for generated YAML, result exports, attack success rates, grader/target errors, filtered reruns, and CI gates. Use promptfoo-provider-setup for connections and promptfoo-redteam-setup for new scan plans.
